CustomField.description: The running user is the opp owner, or the opp owner's manager
CustomField.formula:
OR(
(/* Reporting Level 1 logic */ AND(TEXT($User.Reporting_Level__c) = "1", OR( $User.Email = Owner.Email, $User.Email = Owner.Manager.Email) )) ,
(/* Reporting Level 2 logic */ AND(TEXT($User.Reporting_Level__c) = "2", OR( $User.Email = Owner.Email, $User.Email = Owner.Manager.Email, $User.Email = Owner.Manager.Manager.Email ) ))
)
CustomField.label: Level Reporting Logic
